messages:
Samir Gupta: Heads-up — found an oddity on the Feb invoice: two line items both labeled "Accelerator regulatory fee - eu-west1" for the same amounts. Anyone seen duplicates like this before?
BillingBot: Automated alert: invoice INV-2026-02-28 contains anomalous duplicate tax/support lines. Created ticket BILL-412.
Maria Chen (Finance): I pulled the raw GCP export — there are two separate SKUs with the same description but different sku_ids. Looks like ingestion normalized the description.
Alex Park (Infra): Can you paste the two SKU lines?
Samir Gupta: Sure, snippet from the CSV:
```
sku_id,description,amount,region,usage_start
sku.5a8c,Accelerator regulatory fee - eu-west1,120.00,eu-west1,2026-02-10T00:00:00Z
sku.9f2b,Accelerator regulatory fee - eu-west1,120.00,eu-west1,2026-02-10T00:00:05Z
```
Jeff Liu (Cloud Ops): Hmm — one of those might actually be a support addon that lost its tag when the billing ingestion pipeline flattened the metadata. Upstream provider has a history of sloppy descriptions.
Sophie Martinez (Eng-ML): We did change some resource tagging on dedicated pools last month (changed `accelerator:vendor` -> `accelerator:family`). Could be a tagging mismatch that caused two different internal SKU mappings to collapse to the same description.
Maria Chen (Finance): Reached out to our cloud rep — opening a case w/ their billing ingestion team. Case 123456789. Also re-running our aggregator with sku_id included so we don't dedupe by description.
Samir Gupta: Also flag: I noticed an unexpected per-second rate switch mid-month on one line item (multiplier jump). Might be related, or a separate rate table change.
Alex Park (Infra): Will verify reservation credit mapping — if reserved capacity credits applied only to sku.5a8c and not sku.9f2b, that could create a false double-charge after credits.
Maria Chen (Finance): Temporary mitigation: I'll exclude lines with identical description+region from auto-allocation until we confirm. Re-running allocations now.
BillingBot: Update: cloud support responded — sku.9f2b is labeled as "support-addon" on their side but ingestion stripped the tag. They escalated to ingestion engineering.
Jeff Liu (Cloud Ops): Action item: block auto-credit application for sku.9f2b until ingestion fixes label mapping to avoid credit misapplication.
Sophie Martinez (Eng-ML): I can open a quick PR to add a detector that flags duplicate descriptions within the same billing day/region. Would catch these earlier.
Samir Gupta: Thanks — can we also list the invoice IDs and duplicated amounts in #finance so accounting can prepare the reversal if cloud confirms?
Maria Chen (Finance): Done: INV-2026-02-28, total $112,345.67, duplicated regulatory fees = $240.00. Put a hold on reconciliation for that invoice line. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex Park (Infra): Confirmed our Dedicated commit usage still matches the expected usage numbers, so this is strictly a billing ingestion/description problem, not an actual doubled accelerator usage.
Maria Chen (Finance): Cloud support ETA 48h to confirm ingestion fix and whether a credit will be issued.
BillingBot: Ticket BILL-412 updated: escalated to ingestion team, ETA 48h.
Samir Gupta: OK — follow up in 2 days. If cloud doesn't confirm, we escalate to account manager and open a dispute. :thumbsup:
